message: v1.8.13: feat(notifications): make push and system notifications purposeful and emoji-free (v1.8.13)
changelog: Editorial Landing Page & Interactive Stage Redesign (mobile-web/index.html, mobile-web/landing-motion.js): Rebuilt the landing page using Convert's centered editorial rhythm, spacious display pacing, 2x2 capability card showcase with tilted Swiss pairs, $0 pricing centerpiece, closing atmospheric banner, and centered footer while strictly preserving Blackboarder's Swiss Grid 0px square geometry, Inter Tight + Inter typography, and two-tone dark-first (#121215) / light (#f8fafc) design tokens. Added subtle drifting radial studio lighting with fine SVG film grain, an interactive animated hero demo stage showing Blackboard Ultra announcements being scanned and synced into the extension/companion UI (Calendar, Deadlines, Marks & GPA, Vault), and an interactive sample extractor sandbox (Midterm, Arabic Quiz, Exam Table, Tuition Fee).
